title: Annual Symposium 2026: Memory and Sleep
description:
This year's symposium focuses on memory and sleep, bringing together research across sleep pressure, sleep-dependent plasticity, memory consolidation, brain states, circadian biology, neural dynamics, brain stimulation, sleep measurement, and clinical sleep research.

The symposium provides a friendly and supportive platform for early-career researchers to present their work, receive feedback, and connect with others across Oxford's neuroscience community. Attendance is free and open to all. The event includes a poster session, refreshments, attendee-voted poster prizes, and an informal pub social.

Monday 8 June 2026, Oriel College, 13:30–17:55

Speakers:
• Dr Raffaele Sarnataro — The Francis Crick Institute
• Dr Hannah Alfonsa — Department of Pharmacology, University of Oxford
• Dr Melissa Jones — NDCN, University of Oxford
• Dr Shaun Davidson — Institute of Biomedical Engineering, University of Oxford
• Dr Lukas Krone — DPAG, University of Oxford
• Dr Marcel Kehl — Department of Experimental Psychology, University of Oxford

Opening remarks by Prof. Bernhard Staresina.
